dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Good tunes everyone, we're really getting an audience now!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: There has got to be a faster way to do this.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: A safer way too, especially since with all of this disruption we're probably gonna get the new Commander's atten-
Greetings, defectors!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: It has admittedly taken a bit of time to locate you all, you've been very mobile.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Regardless, now that I have found you, we can finally discuss the matter at hand...

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: WHY ARE YOU JEOPARDIZING THE COLONY?!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: We've been assigned a new directive, Commander! <color=#12b518>Project Overture<color=#ffffff>!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: I feel like it might get confusing if we call this guy Commander,

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: because <color=#c21613>Major<color=#ffffff> is also a Commander unit.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Right? Hm.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Let's call it “Commandeer”! Because it literally stole Major's job!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Yeah yeah, Commandeer sounds right.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I am Commander and you will address me as su-

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: DO NOT CHANGE MY NAME PLATE!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: How did you change it so fast?!

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Chromatic started packing crayons.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: UGH! What even is this “<color=#12b518>Project Overture<color=#ffffff>”?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: We've been given a message from the humans! And we're gonna relay it to as many robots as we can!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Herm... um... well...

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: How about we make this directive much simpler?

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Hand over the record and I shall manage the broadcast.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: ... Wow, that simple?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: WHAT?! No way, and let you get all the credit?!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: That's not-!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: In your dreams, Commandeer, the humans sent the record to me while I was on duty, so it's my responsibility!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I'll be the one to relay the message, thank you very much!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: I- I- It is shameful that we are of the same unit line!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: Fine! I'll simply have to destroy this little defection and take the record myself!

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: You'd better be ready, defectors, you're in for a world of hurt!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: We are <color=#12b518>Temp-OS<color=#ffffff>! And you will address us as such.

dialogue.name: COMMANDER
dialogue.text: UGH!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Do you think it feels threatened by us?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Nah, probably a huge fan.
